newsitem.title: BRAZIL: End to Brazil export tax late for Sept trade - paper.
newsitem.headline: End to Brazil export tax late for Sept trade - paper.

text.p: The benefits of the recent scrapping of a state export tax on primary and semi- manufactured goods will not be seen in Brazil's trade balance in September due to bureaucratic delays, local Estado de Sao Paulo newspaper said on Sunday.
Exporters, principally of agricultural goods such as soybeans and soymeal, have been holding back from overseas sales in anticipation of the lifting of the so-called ICMS tax.
Given the necessary paperwork was only completed two weeks ago, the drop in sales normally seen at this time of year will be more accentuated than usual, Estado said.
